description: This is a test module containing multiple integration test cases for authentication, separation of duties, electronic signature validation, and evidence integrity, all related to a backend API. The tests are marked with pytest and are designed to verify negative scenarios and security controls.

methods.name: test_integration_sod_violation_same_user_submit_and_approve_is_blocked_and_audited()
methods.description: Test to ensure that a separation-of-duty (SoD) violation (same user submit and approve) is blocked and audited.

methods.name: test_integration_esign_invalid_signature_hash_is_rejected_and_no_evidence_created()
